HediffDef.label: quick draw
HediffDef.description: Reflex-driven aiming and firing. The body is snapping the weapon up and pulling the trigger far faster than deliberate aim allows - and hitting anything specific is largely a matter of luck.

HediffDef.label: sustained constructs
HediffDef.description: The caster is holding constructs together with a continuous thread of psychic power. Each sustained construct raises the minimum psychic entropy they can settle down to, and that capacity is returned as soon as the construct is destroyed.
